contexts.text: They at once turned to other gods.
He turned himself about from upon them () = somewhat of drawing back... For the Lord never turns Himself away from anyone, but moderates the influx of good...
Evils and falsities... turn and convert them from the Lord.
Believe that that nation will at last he converted to the Lord. NJHD 248:2.
The heart of Pharaoh and his servants was turned against the people () = a change of the state into evil... To be turned = to he changed.
You could convert stones sooner than them.
The cake is not turned () when the external man rules over the internal; for then the order is inverted...

It is said, Lest it be converted, and healed (), by which is signified, that if they were to understand the internal things of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, they would profane them. NJHD 172:2. DP 231:9. DP 260:2. AE 706:9. AE 1081:2. AE 1160:3.
This is to avert themselves from God, and not convert themselves to God.
This is the case in every turning of their faces and bodies... HH 143. HH 151. TCR 767, Explained. AE 1112:2.
The turnings of the Angels are not like the turnings of men...

That there is such a turning to the Lord is wonderful... for there may be a number together in one place, and each turn the face and body differently from the others, and yet all see the Lord before them...
When an Angel or Spirit comes to a man, and by turning to him, is conjoined with him... HH 252. HH 255.

The interiors and exteriors of man are such, that they are either turned to the Lord as to their common Centre, or to self, thus back from the Lord: those which are turned to the Lord, are also turned to Heaven; and those which are turned to self, are also turned to the world; and those which are turned hither, can with difficulty be elevated; yet they are elevated by the Lord, so far as possible, through the conversion of the love, and this is done through truths from the Word.

When Angels and Spirits turn themselves to a man, they can speak with him at any distance... But when they turn themselves from the man, and speak together, nothing whatever of what they are saying is heard by the man, even if it were close to his ear: hence it is evident that all conjunction in the Spiritual World is according to the conversion.
The emissary Spirit turns himself to the man, and the rest of them to their Spirit... Thus the conjunction of many with one is effected through the conversion.
Some understood, when they were turned to those who were in the light of truth...
When this is done, he turns his face constantly to his own love... HH 512.
They frequently turn themselves to certain quarters... From the turning to the quarters... it is known what is the love which leads them.

A Spirit turns himself towards his like, for thus he breathes his own life... but not when he turns himself in another direction. In the Spiritual World communication with others is effected according to the turning of the face, and those are constantly before, the face who are in a like love, and this in every turning of the body. Hence all infernal Spirits turn themselves back from the Lord... but all the Angels turn themselves to the Lord...
When this sphere is perceived... he is affected at heart... Hence it is that the Spirit turns himself thither...
A third kind of infernal arts relates to the communication and influx of thoughts and affections by conversions, etc.

Man is kept in the freedom of turning himself either to Hell or to Heaven; if he turns himself to Hell, he turns himself away from Heaven; but if he turns himself to Heaven, he turns himself away from Hell...

The Angels turn themselves to the Lord less or more; they who turn themselves more, receive more from heat and less from light; but they who turn themselves less to the Lord, receive more from light and less from heat: hence it is that the Angels are distinguished into two Kingdoms...
All that is here said about the turning of the Angels to the Lord... is also to be understood of man as to his spirit...
This turning to the Lord is an actual turning; it is a kind of elevation...
The man's conversion is described by the unclean Spirit going out from him; and his reversion to his former evils by the return of the unclean Spirit with seven others worse than himself...
That he who is once converted to good and truth is to persevere to the end of life. Signified.
The Jews not yet converted...

All these forms of concupiscences have to be individually converted; the man himself... is to be converted... and each concupiscence of evil is to be converted... and to convert a dragon into a lamb... can only be done successively...
It is easier to convert an owl into a dove than an infernal Spirit into an Angel.

I turned to see the voice that spake with me () = an inversion of the state of those who are in the good of life, as to the perception of truth in the Word, when they turn themselves to the Lord. John said that he heard the voice behind him; and now, that he turned to see the voice; and again, that being turned, he saw seven candlesticks; from which it is evident, that he heard the voice from behind, and that he turned himself... Before man turns himself to the Lord, and acknowledges Him as the God of Heaven and earth, he cannot see the Divine truth in the Word. Explained. AE 9:5. AE 55. AE 61. AE 62.
This conversion of the state of life is what is here meant.
That they will turn themselves to the Lord, and that the Lord will turn Himself to them, because they are conjoined through love. Signified.
Contrariwise, married partners who agree in dispositions and affections turn themselves towards each other.
Hence it is that husbands who are very fond of their wives turn themselves towards them...
Man can turn himself to whichever sphere he pleases, but in proportion as he turns himself to one, he turns himself away from the other. General article.
By turning from God to himself, (man originated evil). TCR 490:2.
They asked, How could man turn himself from God, and turn to himself, when he cannot (do anything) except from God? Explained.
(The doctrine that) in his conversion man is as a stock. BE 69, Explained. TCR 356:end.
After death, all who do good from religion... turn themselves to the Lord God the Saviour.
In order that the conversion of man may take place...
All foreign proselytes who are converted to the Christian religion (also receive baptism).
Man is constantly kept in a state in which repentance and conversion are possible...
Luther... was in a state of conversion above many others...
From the zeal of converting him, I said...
Everything... of Heaven... that comes where there are infernal Genii is converted into evil. Explained.
They cannot be turned from themselves... To be turned from the Lord, is a sign of turning from good, and of turning to evil.
They who are in Hell constantly turn themselves to their own love...
They who are not yet vastated... do not constantly turn themselves to their reigning love. SE 5531.
How Spirits are examined by conversion.
To turn judgment into gall () = to turn truth into falsity... AE 519:6.
All faces are turned into paleness () = no good and truth, but evil and falsity. AE 721:22.
Regeneration through truths from good is signified by, He turned the rock into a pool of waters, and the flint into a fountain of waters ().
The torrents shall be turned into pitch ().
They shall turn to Jehovah () = conversion.
The conversion of those who are a little spiritual. Signified, Explained.
He shall turn the heart of the fathers to the sons, and the heart of the sons to their fathers (). Explained.
Jesus turned, and said unto Peter ().
Peter's being converted () = the truth from good which is from the Lord.
How then art thou turned ().
Can the Ethiopian change his skin? () = that evil cannot change its nature.
Then Peter, turning about (). AE 821:6.
As truth turns itself to good, so truth is vivified.
